items.question: Trong câu "A hash table (hash map) stores key-value pairs.", từ "pair" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A hash table (hash map) stores key-value pairs.", what does "pair" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a sequence of items in a row
a large group of similar things
a set of two things used together
items.explanation: pair /peə(r)/ (danh từ): cặp, đôi. "Key-value pair" = cặp khóa–giá trị: mỗi phần tử gồm một khóa đi kèm một giá trị.
items.explanationEn: pair /peə(r)/ (noun): a set of two things used together. A "key-value pair" is one key joined with the value it maps to.

items.question: Trong câu "Like an array it is backed by contiguous slots, but you look values up by a meaningful key instead of a numeric index, and the keys have no order.", từ "contiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Like an array it is backed by contiguous slots, but you look values up by a meaningful key instead of a numeric index, and the keys have no order.", what does "contiguous" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: next to each other in sequence
items.explanation: contiguous /kənˈtɪɡjuəs/ (tính từ): liền kề, sát nhau. "Contiguous memory" = vùng nhớ liền mạch, các ô nằm sát nhau nên truy cập theo chỉ số rất nhanh.
items.explanationEn: contiguous /kənˈtɪɡjuəs/ (adjective): next to each other in sequence. "Contiguous memory" means the cells sit side by side, which makes index access fast.

items.question: Trong câu "Like an array it is backed by contiguous slots, but you look values up by a meaningful key instead of a numeric index, and the keys have no order.", từ "slot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Like an array it is backed by contiguous slots, but you look values up by a meaningful key instead of a numeric index, and the keys have no order.", what does "slot" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a narrow opening in a machine
a position that holds one item
items.explanation: slot /slɒt/ (danh từ): ô, vị trí chứa. "Array slot" = một ô trong mảng; còn "time slot" lại là khung giờ trong lịch.
items.explanationEn: slot /slɒt/ (noun): a position that holds one item. An "array slot" is one cell of an array, while a "time slot" is a period in a schedule.

items.question: Trong câu "Its selling point is speed: on average, insert, lookup and delete are all O(1) — something neither arrays (O(n) search) nor linked lists (O(n) access) give you.", từ "selling point" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Its selling point is speed: on average, insert, lookup and delete are all O(1) — something neither arrays (O(n) search) nor linked lists (O(n) access) give you.", what does "selling point" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the retail price of a product
the starting position of a process
items.explanation: selling point /ˈselɪŋ pɔɪnt/ (cụm từ): ưu điểm nổi bật. Hay dùng khi nêu lý do chính khiến người ta chọn một công nghệ: "its main selling point is...".
items.explanationEn: selling point /ˈselɪŋ pɔɪnt/ (phrase): the main advantage of something. Often used to name the main reason people choose a technology: "its main selling point is...".

items.question: Trong câu "Its selling point is speed: on average, insert, lookup and delete are all O(1) — something neither arrays (O(n) search) nor linked lists (O(n) access) give you.", từ "on average" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Its selling point is speed: on average, insert, lookup and delete are all O(1) — something neither arrays (O(n) search) nor linked lists (O(n) access) give you.", what does "on average" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on average /ɒn ˈævərɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): tính trung bình. Trong phân tích độ phức tạp, "on average" đối lập với "in the worst case".
items.explanationEn: on average /ɒn ˈævərɪdʒ/ (phrase): typically, when averaged out. In complexity analysis, "on average" is contrasted with "in the worst case".

items.question: Trong câu "Every mainstream language ships one: JavaScript Map/Set (and plain objects, with restrictions), Python dict, Java HashMap, Go map, Ruby Hash.", từ "mainstream" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every mainstream language ships one: JavaScript Map/Set (and plain objects, with restrictions), Python dict, Java HashMap, Go map, Ruby Hash.", what does "mainstream" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mainstream /ˈmeɪnstriːm/ (tính từ): phổ biến, chủ đạo. "Mainstream language" = ngôn ngữ lập trình được dùng rộng rãi, đối lập với "niche language".
items.explanationEn: mainstream /ˈmeɪnstriːm/ (adjective): widely used and popular. A "mainstream language" is widely used, as opposed to a "niche language".

items.question: Trong câu "Every mainstream language ships one: JavaScript Map/Set (and plain objects, with restrictions), Python dict, Java HashMap, Go map, Ruby Hash.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every mainstream language ships one: JavaScript Map/Set (and plain objects, with restrictions), Python dict, Java HashMap, Go map, Ruby Hash.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): đi kèm, cung cấp sẵn. Trong phần mềm, "ship" = phát hành hoặc cung cấp kèm sản phẩm, ví dụ "ship a feature".
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to include as standard. In software, "ship" means to release or include with a product, as in "ship a feature".

items.question: Trong câu "The question for this topic: if built-in hash tables disappeared, how would we build one ourselves?", từ "built-in" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The question for this topic: if built-in hash tables disappeared, how would we build one ourselves?", what does "built-in" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: included as part of the system
items.explanation: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (tính từ): có sẵn, tích hợp. "Built-in function/type" = hàm hoặc kiểu dữ liệu ngôn ngữ cung cấp sẵn, không cần cài thêm.
items.explanationEn: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (adjective): included as part of the system. A "built-in function/type" comes with the language and needs no extra install.

items.question: Trong câu "The trick is to keep an ordinary array and add a function that converts any key into a valid array index.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The trick is to keep an ordinary array and add a function that converts any key into a valid array index.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi. Cấu trúc "convert A into/to B" = chuyển A thành B; hàm băm chuyển khóa thành chỉ số.
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into another form. The pattern is "convert A into/to B"; a hash function converts a key into an index.

items.question: Trong câu "The trick is to keep an ordinary array and add a function that converts any key into a valid array index.", từ "trick" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The trick is to keep an ordinary array and add a function that converts any key into a valid array index.", what does "trick" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a clever way of doing something
an act meant to deceive someone
items.explanation: trick /trɪk/ (danh từ): mẹo, cách làm khéo. "The trick is to..." = bí quyết là...; dùng khi giới thiệu ý tưởng then chốt của lời giải.
items.explanationEn: trick /trɪk/ (noun): a clever way of doing something. "The trick is to..." introduces the key idea behind a solution.

items.question: Trong câu "We store the key together with the value in the slot, because (as we will see) several keys can end up at the same index and we need to tell them apart.", từ "tell apart" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "We store the key together with the value in the slot, because (as we will see) several keys can end up at the same index and we need to tell them apart.", what does "tell apart" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tell apart /tel əˈpɑːt/ (cụm từ): phân biệt. "Tell A and B apart" = phân biệt A với B; lưu cả khóa giúp phân biệt các khóa trùng chỉ số.
items.explanationEn: tell apart /tel əˈpɑːt/ (phrase): to see the difference between. "Tell A and B apart" means distinguish them; storing the key lets us distinguish keys sharing an index.

items.question: Trong câu "Here we mean a hash for data structures, not a cryptographic hash (SHA-256 is deliberately slow and has goals like pre-image resistance that we do not need).", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here we mean a hash for data structures, not a cryptographic hash (SHA-256 is deliberately slow and has goals like pre-image resistance that we do not need).", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (trạng từ): cố ý, có chủ đích. Đồng nghĩa với "on purpose"; hàm băm mật mã được làm chậm có chủ đích để chống dò tìm.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (adverb): on purpose. A synonym of "on purpose"; cryptographic hashes are made slow on purpose to resist guessing.

items.question: Trong câu "Uniform — spreads keys evenly over all indices instead of clustering them.", từ "evenly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Uniform — spreads keys evenly over all indices instead of clustering them.", what does "evenly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: evenly /ˈiːvənli/ (trạng từ): đồng đều. "Spread evenly" = rải đều; hàm băm tốt rải khóa đều trên các ô.
items.explanationEn: evenly /ˈiːvənli/ (adverb): in equal amounts. "Spread evenly" means distribute equally; a good hash spreads keys evenly over slots.

items.question: Trong câu "Deterministic — the same key always produces the same index.", từ "deterministic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deterministic — the same key always produces the same index.", what does "deterministic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deterministic /dɪˌtɜːmɪˈnɪstɪk/ (tính từ): tất định, nhất quán. Hàm "deterministic" luôn trả cùng kết quả cho cùng đầu vào, trái nghĩa với "random".
items.explanationEn: deterministic /dɪˌtɜːmɪˈnɪstɪk/ (adjective): always giving the same output. A "deterministic" function always returns the same result for the same input; the opposite is "random".

items.question: Trong câu "Determinism is non-negotiable: a random hash is not slow, it is broken — you could never find a value again.", từ "non-negotiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Determinism is non-negotiable: a random hash is not slow, it is broken — you could never find a value again.", what does "non-negotiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: non-negotiable /ˌnɒnnɪˈɡəʊʃiəbl/ (tính từ): bắt buộc, không thể bỏ. Dùng cho yêu cầu tuyệt đối không được thỏa hiệp: "security is non-negotiable".
items.explanationEn: non-negotiable /ˌnɒnnɪˈɡəʊʃiəbl/ (adjective): required, not open to debate. Used for a requirement that allows no compromise: "security is non-negotiable".

items.question: Trong câu "The modulo is what guarantees a valid index: x % len is always between 0 and len - 1 for non-negative x.", từ "guarantee" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The modulo is what guarantees a valid index: x % len is always between 0 and len - 1 for non-negative x.", what does "guarantee" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (động từ): đảm bảo. "Guarantee that..." = đảm bảo rằng...; phép modulo đảm bảo chỉ số luôn nằm trong mảng.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (verb): to make certain. "Guarantee that..." means make sure that...; modulo guarantees the index stays inside the array.

items.question: Trong câu "Poor distribution — addition ignores letter order, so every anagram collides:", từ "distribution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Poor distribution — addition ignores letter order, so every anagram collides:", what does "distribution" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distribution /ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃn/ (danh từ): sự phân bố. "Poor/good distribution" = phân bố kém/tốt; nói về việc khóa rải đều hay dồn cục.
items.explanationEn: distribution /ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃn/ (noun): how items are spread out. "Poor/good distribution" describes whether keys are spread out or bunched together.

items.question: Trong câu "Poor distribution — addition ignores letter order, so every anagram collides:", từ "anagram" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Poor distribution — addition ignores letter order, so every anagram collides:", what does "anagram" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a word with a similar meaning
a shortened form of a word
a word with an opposite meaning
items.explanation: anagram /ˈænəɡræm/ (danh từ): từ đảo chữ cái. "listen" và "silent" là anagram của nhau; "group anagrams" là bài phỏng vấn kinh điển.
items.explanationEn: anagram /ˈænəɡræm/ (noun): a word with rearranged letters. "listen" and "silent" are anagrams; "group anagrams" is a classic interview problem.

items.question: Trong câu "Poor distribution — addition ignores letter order, so every anagram collides:", từ "collide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Poor distribution — addition ignores letter order, so every anagram collides:", what does "collide" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to clash at the same point
items.explanation: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (động từ): trùng nhau, va chạm. Trong hash table, hai khóa "collide" khi băm ra cùng một chỉ số; danh từ là "collision".
items.explanationEn: collide /kəˈlaɪd/ (verb): to clash at the same point. In a hash table, two keys "collide" when they hash to the same index; the noun is "collision".

items.question: Trong câu "Math.min(key.length, 100) caps the work, so the hash is effectively O(1) (at the price of more collisions for keys sharing a long prefix).", từ "cap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Math.min(key.length, 100) caps the work, so the hash is effectively O(1) (at the price of more collisions for keys sharing a long prefix).", what does "cap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set an upper limit on
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (động từ): giới hạn mức tối đa. "Cap something at N" = giới hạn tối đa ở N; ở đây chỉ xét tối đa 100 ký tự.
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit on. "Cap something at N" means limit it to at most N; here only 100 characters are hashed.

items.question: Trong câu "Math.min(key.length, 100) caps the work, so the hash is effectively O(1) (at the price of more collisions for keys sharing a long prefix).", từ "effectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Math.min(key.length, 100) caps the work, so the hash is effectively O(1) (at the price of more collisions for keys sharing a long prefix).", what does "effectively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: effectively /ɪˈfektɪvli/ (trạng từ): trên thực tế, gần như. Nghĩa "về thực chất" khác nghĩa "hiệu quả": "effectively O(1)" = coi như O(1).
items.explanationEn: effectively /ɪˈfektɪvli/ (adverb): in practice, virtually. The sense "in effect" differs from "successfully": "effectively O(1)" means O(1) for practical purposes.

items.question: Trong câu "Math.min(key.length, 100) caps the work, so the hash is effectively O(1) (at the price of more collisions for keys sharing a long prefix).", từ "at the price of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Math.min(key.length, 100) caps the work, so the hash is effectively O(1) (at the price of more collisions for keys sharing a long prefix).", what does "at the price of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at the price of /æt ðə praɪs əv/ (cụm từ): đổi lại bằng việc. Dùng để nêu cái giá phải trả cho một lợi ích: nhanh hơn nhưng đổi lại nhiều xung đột hơn.
items.explanationEn: at the price of /æt ðə praɪs əv/ (phrase): at the cost of. Names what you give up for a benefit: faster hashing at the cost of more collisions.

items.question: Trong câu "A prime multiplier and a prime table length share no common factors, so the multiplication actually mixes bits across all slots.", từ "factor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A prime multiplier and a prime table length share no common factors, so the multiplication actually mixes bits across all slots.", what does "factor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a cause that affects a result
items.explanation: factor /ˈfæktə(r)/ (danh từ): thừa số, ước số. "Common factor" = ước chung; hai số nguyên tố khác nhau không có ước chung nào ngoài 1.
items.explanationEn: factor /ˈfæktə(r)/ (noun): a number that divides another. A "common factor" divides both numbers; two different primes share none except 1.

items.question: Trong câu "That is why the class below defaults to size 53.", từ "default" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is why the class below defaults to size 53.", what does "default" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fail to repay a debt
to use as the preset value
items.explanation: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (động từ): mặc định là. "Default to X" = lấy X làm giá trị mặc định khi không truyền tham số.
items.explanationEn: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (verb): to use as the preset value. "Default to X" means use X when no value is passed in.

items.question: Trong câu "Gotcha: charCodeAt(i) - 96 is negative for uppercase letters and digits ("A" gives -31), and JavaScript's % keeps the sign (-5 % 53 === -5) — you get a negative index.", từ "gotcha" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gotcha: charCodeAt(i) - 96 is negative for uppercase letters and digits ("A" gives -31), and JavaScript's % keeps the sign (-5 % 53 === -5) — you get a negative index.", what does "gotcha" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gotcha /ˈɡɒtʃə/ (danh từ): cái bẫy dễ mắc. Từ thân mật trong tài liệu kỹ thuật, chỉ chỗ dễ gây lỗi bất ngờ; gần nghĩa với "pitfall".
items.explanationEn: gotcha /ˈɡɒtʃə/ (noun): a hidden trap or pitfall. An informal word in technical docs for an unexpected source of bugs; close to "pitfall".

items.question: Trong câu "The class below uses the raw char code to avoid this.", từ "raw" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The class below uses the raw char code to avoid this.", what does "raw" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: raw /rɔː/ (tính từ): nguyên gốc, chưa xử lý. "Raw data/value" = dữ liệu thô, chưa qua biến đổi; ở đây là mã ký tự không trừ 96.
items.explanationEn: raw /rɔː/ (adjective): unprocessed, in original form. "Raw data/value" is untransformed; here it is the char code without subtracting 96.

items.question: Trong câu "Pigeonhole principle — there are infinitely many possible string keys but only m slots, so some keys must share.", từ "infinitely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pigeonhole principle — there are infinitely many possible string keys but only m slots, so some keys must share.", what does "infinitely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: infinitely /ˈɪnfɪnətli/ (trạng từ): vô hạn, vô số. "Infinitely many" = vô số; số khóa vô hạn nhưng số ô hữu hạn nên phải có xung đột.
items.explanationEn: infinitely /ˈɪnfɪnətli/ (adverb): without any limit. "Infinitely many" means without limit; infinite keys but finite slots force collisions.

items.question: Trong câu "Birthday paradox — with just 23 people, two share a birthday with >50% probability out of 365 days.", từ "probability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Birthday paradox — with just 23 people, two share a birthday with >50% probability out of 365 days.", what does "probability" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a share out of a hundred
items.explanation: probability /ˌprɒbəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): xác suất. "With X% probability" = với xác suất X%; nghịch lý ngày sinh dựa trên phép tính xác suất.
items.explanationEn: probability /ˌprɒbəˈbɪləti/ (noun): how likely something is. "With X% probability" states a chance; the birthday paradox is a probability result.

items.question: Trong câu "Birthday paradox — with just 23 people, two share a birthday with >50% probability out of 365 days.", từ "paradox" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Birthday paradox — with just 23 people, two share a birthday with >50% probability out of 365 days.", what does "paradox" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a puzzle or riddle to solve
an event that happens by chance
items.explanation: paradox /ˈpærədɒks/ (danh từ): nghịch lý. "Birthday paradox" gọi là nghịch lý vì kết quả trái với trực giác của hầu hết mọi người.
items.explanationEn: paradox /ˈpærədɒks/ (noun): a seemingly contradictory truth. The "birthday paradox" is called a paradox because the result goes against most people's intuition.

items.question: Trong câu "So a hash table is really a hash function plus a collision-resolution strategy.", từ "strategy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So a hash table is really a hash function plus a collision-resolution strategy.", what does "strategy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: strategy /ˈstrætədʒi/ (danh từ): chiến lược. "Collision-resolution strategy" = chiến lược xử lý xung đột, như chaining hoặc probing.
items.explanationEn: strategy /ˈstrætədʒi/ (noun): a planned approach. A "collision-resolution strategy" is a planned way to handle collisions, such as chaining or probing.

items.question: Trong câu "With separate chaining, each array slot holds a small collection — an array or a linked list — of all the pairs that hashed there (a "bucket").", từ "separate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With separate chaining, each array slot holds a small collection — an array or a linked list — of all the pairs that hashed there (a "bucket").", what does "separate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: separate /ˈsepərət/ (tính từ): riêng biệt. Tính từ đọc /ˈsepərət/, còn động từ "separate" đọc /ˈsepəreɪt/; mỗi ô có chuỗi riêng.
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsepərət/ (adjective): individual, kept apart. The adjective is /ˈsepərət/ while the verb is /ˈsepəreɪt/; each slot has its own chain.

items.question: Trong câu "set: hash, then scan the bucket.", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "set: hash, then scan the bucket.", what does "scan" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to look through item by item
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (động từ): rà soát, duyệt qua. "Scan a list/bucket" = duyệt từng phần tử để tìm; "linear scan" tốn O(n).
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to look through item by item. "Scan a list/bucket" means check items one by one; a "linear scan" costs O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "If the key exists, update its value; otherwise push a new pair.", từ "otherwise" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the key exists, update its value; otherwise push a new pair.", what does "otherwise" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (trạng từ): nếu không thì. Thường đứng sau dấu chấm phẩy để nêu nhánh còn lại, tương đương "else" trong code.
items.explanationEn: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (adverb): if not, in other cases. Often follows a semicolon to give the other branch, like "else" in code.

items.question: Trong câu "delete: hash, then remove the matching pair from the bucket.", từ "matching" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "delete: hash, then remove the matching pair from the bucket.", what does "matching" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: of the same colour or style
items.explanation: matching /ˈmætʃɪŋ/ (tính từ): khớp, trùng khớp. "The matching pair/record" = cặp/bản ghi khớp với điều kiện tìm kiếm.
items.explanationEn: matching /ˈmætʃɪŋ/ (adjective): that corresponds exactly. "The matching pair/record" is the one that meets the search condition.

items.question: Trong câu "Chaining degrades gracefully: the table still works when there are more keys than slots, just slower.", từ "degrade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chaining degrades gracefully: the table still works when there are more keys than slots, just slower.", what does "degrade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: degrade /dɪˈɡreɪd/ (động từ): suy giảm dần. "Performance degrades" = hiệu năng giảm dần; danh từ là "degradation".
items.explanationEn: degrade /dɪˈɡreɪd/ (verb): to become worse in quality. "Performance degrades" means it gets gradually worse; the noun is "degradation".

items.question: Trong câu "Chaining degrades gracefully: the table still works when there are more keys than slots, just slower.", từ "gracefully" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chaining degrades gracefully: the table still works when there are more keys than slots, just slower.", what does "gracefully" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: gracefully /ˈɡreɪsfəli/ (trạng từ): êm, không đột ngột. "Degrade gracefully" = vẫn chạy được khi quá tải, chỉ chậm đi chứ không hỏng hẳn.
items.explanationEn: gracefully /ˈɡreɪsfəli/ (adverb): smoothly, without breaking. "Degrade gracefully" means keep working under stress, only slower, instead of failing.

items.question: Trong câu "Linear probing stores exactly one pair per slot.", từ "linear" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linear probing stores exactly one pair per slot.", what does "linear" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: step by step in a line
items.explanation: linear /ˈlɪniə(r)/ (tính từ): tuần tự, theo hàng. "Linear probing" dò lần lượt từng ô kế tiếp; "linear time" là thời gian O(n).
items.explanationEn: linear /ˈlɪniə(r)/ (adjective): step by step in a line. "Linear probing" checks the next slots one by one; "linear time" means O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "On a collision it walks forward (index + 1, wrapping around) until it finds an empty slot.", từ "wrap around" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On a collision it walks forward (index + 1, wrapping around) until it finds an empty slot.", what does "wrap around" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to go back to the start
items.explanation: wrap around /ræp əˈraʊnd/ (cụm từ): quay vòng về đầu. Khi đi quá ô cuối, chỉ số "wraps around" về 0, thường cài bằng phép % độ dài.
items.explanationEn: wrap around /ræp əˈraʊnd/ (phrase): to go back to the start. Past the last slot the index "wraps around" to 0, usually done with % length.

items.question: Trong câu "get("tomato") probes 4, 5, 6 and stops when it finds the key — or at an empty slot, which proves the key is absent.", từ "absent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "get("tomato") probes 4, 5, 6 and stops when it finds the key — or at an empty slot, which proves the key is absent.", what does "absent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: absent /ˈæbsənt/ (tính từ): không có mặt. Trái nghĩa với "present"; gặp ô trống chứng tỏ khóa không có trong bảng.
items.explanationEn: absent /ˈæbsənt/ (adjective): not present. The opposite of "present"; reaching an empty slot shows the key is not in the table.

items.question: Trong câu "get("tomato") probes 4, 5, 6 and stops when it finds the key — or at an empty slot, which proves the key is absent.", từ "prove" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "get("tomato") probes 4, 5, 6 and stops when it finds the key — or at an empty slot, which proves the key is absent.", what does "prove" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prove /pruːv/ (động từ): chứng tỏ, chứng minh. "Prove that..." = chứng minh rằng...; danh từ là "proof".
items.explanationEn: prove /pruːv/ (verb): to show to be true. "Prove that..." means show that it is true; the noun is "proof".

items.question: Trong câu "Trade-offs versus chaining:", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trade-offs versus chaining:", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a balance of gains and losses
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Trade-off between A and B" = sự đánh đổi giữa A và B; từ rất hay gặp khi so sánh giải pháp.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (noun): a balance of gains and losses. A "trade-off between A and B" means gaining one costs the other; common when comparing designs.

items.question: Trong câu "Trade-offs versus chaining:", từ "versus" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trade-offs versus chaining:", what does "versus" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: versus /ˈvɜːsəs/ (giới từ): so với. Thường viết tắt "vs.", dùng khi đặt hai lựa chọn cạnh nhau để so sánh.
items.explanationEn: versus /ˈvɜːsəs/ (preposition): compared with. Often shortened to "vs.", used to set two options side by side.

items.question: Trong câu "Why tombstones: if you simply empty slot 5 (salmon), a later get("tomato") stops at the empty slot 5 and wrongly reports "not found".", từ "tombstone" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why tombstones: if you simply empty slot 5 (salmon), a later get("tomato") stops at the empty slot 5 and wrongly reports "not found".", what does "tombstone" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a marker for a deleted entry
items.explanation: tombstone /ˈtuːmstəʊn/ (danh từ): dấu đánh dấu đã xóa. Nghĩa đen là bia mộ; trong cơ sở dữ liệu và hash table là dấu "đã xóa, cứ dò tiếp".
items.explanationEn: tombstone /ˈtuːmstəʊn/ (noun): a marker for a deleted entry. Literally a grave marker; in databases and hash tables it marks "deleted, keep searching".

items.question: Trong câu "Why tombstones: if you simply empty slot 5 (salmon), a later get("tomato") stops at the empty slot 5 and wrongly reports "not found".", từ "wrongly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why tombstones: if you simply empty slot 5 (salmon), a later get("tomato") stops at the empty slot 5 and wrongly reports "not found".", what does "wrongly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: wrongly /ˈrɒŋli/ (trạng từ): sai, nhầm. "Wrongly report/assume" = báo/giả định sai; đồng nghĩa "incorrectly".
items.explanationEn: wrongly /ˈrɒŋli/ (adverb): incorrectly. "Wrongly report/assume" means do so incorrectly; a synonym of "incorrectly".

items.question: Trong câu "Primary clustering: runs of full slots grow and slow every probe", từ "primary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Primary clustering: runs of full slots grow and slow every probe", what does "primary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: primary /ˈpraɪməri/ (tính từ): chính, chủ yếu. "Primary clustering" = hiện tượng dồn cục chính của linear probing; "primary key" = khóa chính.
items.explanationEn: primary /ˈpraɪməri/ (adjective): main, chief. "Primary clustering" is linear probing's main clumping problem; compare "primary key".

items.question: Trong câu "We implement separate chaining with arrays as buckets.", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "We implement separate chaining with arrays as buckets.", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪmplɪment/ (động từ): cài đặt, hiện thực. "Implement an algorithm/interface" = viết code hiện thực thuật toán/giao diện.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪmplɪment/ (verb): to put into working code. "Implement an algorithm/interface" means write the code that makes it work.

items.question: Trong câu "Both methods are O(1) average (hash + short bucket scan) and O(n) worst case when every key lands in one bucket.", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both methods are O(1) average (hash + short bucket scan) and O(n) worst case when every key lands in one bucket.", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /wɜːst keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. "In the worst case" = trong trường hợp xấu nhất; đi cùng "best case" và "average case".
items.explanationEn: worst case /wɜːst keɪs/ (phrase): the least favourable scenario. "In the worst case" pairs with "best case" and "average case" in complexity analysis.

items.question: Trong câu "Both methods are O(1) average (hash + short bucket scan) and O(n) worst case when every key lands in one bucket.", từ "land" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both methods are O(1) average (hash + short bucket scan) and O(n) worst case when every key lands in one bucket.", what does "land" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to come down from the air
items.explanation: land /lænd/ (động từ): rơi vào, nằm ở. "Land in/on" = rốt cuộc rơi vào đâu; khóa "lands in" một bucket sau khi băm.
items.explanationEn: land /lænd/ (verb): to end up in. "Land in/on" means end up somewhere; a key "lands in" a bucket after hashing.

items.question: Trong câu "To list keys or values we must walk every slot of the underlying array, including empty ones.", từ "underlying" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To list keys or values we must walk every slot of the underlying array, including empty ones.", what does "underlying" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: underlying /ˌʌndəˈlaɪɪŋ/ (tính từ): nằm bên dưới, nền tảng. "Underlying array/structure" = cấu trúc nền mà lớp trừu tượng dựa vào.
items.explanationEn: underlying /ˌʌndəˈlaɪɪŋ/ (adjective): lying beneath as the base. The "underlying array/structure" is what an abstraction is built on.

items.question: Trong câu "Both methods are O(1) average (hash + short bucket scan) and O(n) worst case when every key lands in one bucket.", từ "method" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both methods are O(1) average (hash + short bucket scan) and O(n) worst case when every key lands in one bucket.", what does "method" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a function defined on a class
a data field on a class
items.explanation: method /ˈmeθəd/ (danh từ): phương thức của lớp. Trong OOP, "method" là hàm gắn với lớp, như set() và get() của HashTable.
items.explanationEn: method /ˈmeθəd/ (noun): a function defined on a class. In OOP, a "method" is a function belonging to a class, like HashTable's set() and get().

items.question: Trong câu "Not O(1), and a huge mostly-empty table still costs O(m).", từ "mostly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not O(1), and a huge mostly-empty table still costs O(m).", what does "mostly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: mostly /ˈməʊstli/ (trạng từ): phần lớn, chủ yếu. "Mostly-empty" = gần như trống; bảng lớn mà ít dữ liệu vẫn tốn O(m) để duyệt.
items.explanationEn: mostly /ˈməʊstli/ (adverb): for the most part. "Mostly-empty" means nearly empty; a big sparse table still costs O(m) to walk.

items.question: Trong câu "Because set updates existing keys, keys() never returns duplicates.", từ "duplicate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because set updates existing keys, keys() never returns duplicates.", what does "duplicate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ (danh từ): bản trùng lặp. Danh từ đọc /ˈdjuːplɪkət/, động từ đọc /ˈdjuːplɪkeɪt/; "no duplicates" = không trùng lặp.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ (noun): a repeated copy. The noun is /ˈdjuːplɪkət/, the verb /ˈdjuːplɪkeɪt/; "no duplicates" means no repeats.

items.question: Trong câu "Because set updates existing keys, keys() never returns duplicates.", từ "existing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because set updates existing keys, keys() never returns duplicates.", what does "existing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: existing /ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ/ (tính từ): đã có sẵn. "Update an existing key" = cập nhật khóa đã có, thay vì thêm bản mới.
items.explanationEn: existing /ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ/ (adjective): already present. "Update an existing key" means change a key that is already there instead of adding a new one.

items.question: Trong câu "Values can legitimately repeat (two colours with the same hex code); if you want unique values, deduplicate with a Set in O(n) rather than includes in O(n²).", từ "legitimately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Values can legitimately repeat (two colours with the same hex code); if you want unique values, deduplicate with a Set in O(n) rather than includes in O(n²).", what does "legitimately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: legitimately /lɪˈdʒɪtɪmətli/ (trạng từ): một cách hợp lệ. Nhấn mạnh việc giá trị lặp là bình thường, không phải lỗi; tính từ là "legitimate".
items.explanationEn: legitimately /lɪˈdʒɪtɪmətli/ (adverb): in a valid way. Stresses that repeated values are normal, not a bug; the adjective is "legitimate".

items.question: Trong câu "Values can legitimately repeat (two colours with the same hex code); if you want unique values, deduplicate with a Set in O(n) rather than includes in O(n²).", từ "deduplicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Values can legitimately repeat (two colours with the same hex code); if you want unique values, deduplicate with a Set in O(n) rather than includes in O(n²).", what does "deduplicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deduplicate /diːˈdjuːplɪkeɪt/ (động từ): loại bỏ trùng lặp. Hay viết tắt "dedupe"; trong JS thường dùng new Set(arr) để loại trùng.
items.explanationEn: deduplicate /diːˈdjuːplɪkeɪt/ (verb): to remove repeated items. Often shortened to "dedupe"; in JS, new Set(arr) is the usual way to do it.

items.question: Trong câu "Values can legitimately repeat (two colours with the same hex code); if you want unique values, deduplicate with a Set in O(n) rather than includes in O(n²).", từ "unique" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Values can legitimately repeat (two colours with the same hex code); if you want unique values, deduplicate with a Set in O(n) rather than includes in O(n²).", what does "unique" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unique /juˈniːk/ (tính từ): duy nhất, không lặp. "Unique values" = các giá trị không trùng nhau; "unique key" = khóa duy nhất.
items.explanationEn: unique /juˈniːk/ (adjective): with no repeats. "Unique values" have no repeats; a "unique key" appears only once.

items.question: Trong câu "The order follows slot positions, i.e. it looks random — a plain hash table has no meaningful ordering.", từ "meaningful" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The order follows slot positions, i.e. it looks random — a plain hash table has no meaningful ordering.", what does "meaningful" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: meaningful /ˈmiːnɪŋfl/ (tính từ): có ý nghĩa. "No meaningful order" = không có thứ tự nào mang ý nghĩa, trông như ngẫu nhiên.
items.explanationEn: meaningful /ˈmiːnɪŋfl/ (adjective): having a useful sense. "No meaningful order" means the order carries no useful information and looks random.

items.question: Trong câu "The order follows slot positions, i.e. it looks random — a plain hash table has no meaningful ordering.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The order follows slot positions, i.e. it looks random — a plain hash table has no meaningful ordering.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): thông thường, cơ bản. "Plain object/text" = đối tượng/văn bản thông thường, không kèm tính năng thêm.
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): basic, without extras. A "plain object/text" is ordinary, with no extra features.

items.question: Trong câu "The average case assumes a good hash and a bounded load factor.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The average case assumes a good hash and a bounded load factor.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): giả định. "Assume that..." = giả định rằng...; danh từ là "assumption".
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take as given. "Assume that..." means take it as true without proof; the noun is "assumption".

items.question: Trong câu "The average case assumes a good hash and a bounded load factor.", từ "bounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The average case assumes a good hash and a bounded load factor.", what does "bounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bounded /ˈbaʊndɪd/ (tính từ): bị giới hạn. "Bounded load factor" = hệ số tải không vượt quá một mức; trái nghĩa "unbounded".
items.explanationEn: bounded /ˈbaʊndɪd/ (adjective): kept within a limit. A "bounded load factor" never exceeds some limit; the opposite is "unbounded".

items.question: Trong câu "Worst cases also occur through hash flooding attacks (keys crafted to collide), which is why runtimes use seeded hash functions.", từ "occur" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Worst cases also occur through hash flooding attacks (keys crafted to collide), which is why runtimes use seeded hash functions.", what does "occur" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: occur /əˈkɜː(r)/ (động từ): xảy ra. Trang trọng hơn "happen"; danh từ là "occurrence" (lần xuất hiện).
items.explanationEn: occur /əˈkɜː(r)/ (verb): to happen. More formal than "happen"; the noun is "occurrence".

items.question: Trong câu "Worst cases also occur through hash flooding attacks (keys crafted to collide), which is why runtimes use seeded hash functions.", từ "craft" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Worst cases also occur through hash flooding attacks (keys crafted to collide), which is why runtimes use seeded hash functions.", what does "craft" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make by hand as art
items.explanation: craft /krɑːft/ (động từ): chế tạo có chủ ý. "Crafted input/keys" = dữ liệu được kẻ tấn công cố tình tạo ra để gây hại.
items.explanationEn: craft /krɑːft/ (verb): to design deliberately. "Crafted input/keys" are made on purpose by an attacker to cause harm.

items.question: Trong câu "With linear probing α must stay below 1, and performance collapses as it approaches 1.", từ "collapse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With linear probing α must stay below 1, and performance collapses as it approaches 1.", what does "collapse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fall down, of a building
items.explanation: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (động từ): sụt giảm mạnh. "Performance collapses" = hiệu năng tụt thê thảm, mạnh hơn "degrades".
items.explanationEn: collapse /kəˈlæps/ (verb): to drop sharply. "Performance collapses" means it drops badly, stronger than "degrades".

items.question: Trong câu "With linear probing α must stay below 1, and performance collapses as it approaches 1.", từ "approach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With linear probing α must stay below 1, and performance collapses as it approaches 1.", what does "approach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (động từ): tiến gần tới. "As α approaches 1" = khi α tiến dần tới 1; trong toán, "approach a limit".
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (verb): to get closer to. "As α approaches 1" means as it gets close to 1; in maths, "approach a limit".

items.question: Trong câu "When α crosses the threshold, the table resizes: allocate an array roughly twice as big (ideally a prime), then rehash every pair, because each index depends on % this.keyMap.length.", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When α crosses the threshold, the table resizes: allocate an array roughly twice as big (ideally a prime), then rehash every pair, because each index depends on % this.keyMap.length.", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a limit that triggers a change
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃhəʊld/ (danh từ): mức ngưỡng giới hạn. "Cross/exceed a threshold" = vượt ngưỡng; vượt ngưỡng 0.75 thì bảng được mở rộng.
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃhəʊld/ (noun): a limit that triggers a change. "Cross/exceed a threshold" means pass the limit; past 0.75 the table resizes.

items.question: Trong câu "When α crosses the threshold, the table resizes: allocate an array roughly twice as big (ideally a prime), then rehash every pair, because each index depends on % this.keyMap.length.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When α crosses the threshold, the table resizes: allocate an array roughly twice as big (ideally a prime), then rehash every pair, because each index depends on % this.keyMap.length.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (động từ): cấp phát bộ nhớ. "Allocate memory/an array" = cấp phát; danh từ "allocation", trái nghĩa "free/deallocate".
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (verb): to reserve memory. "Allocate memory/an array" means reserve it; the noun is "allocation", the opposite "free/deallocate".

items.question: Trong câu "When α crosses the threshold, the table resizes: allocate an array roughly twice as big (ideally a prime), then rehash every pair, because each index depends on % this.keyMap.length.", từ "ideally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When α crosses the threshold, the table resizes: allocate an array roughly twice as big (ideally a prime), then rehash every pair, because each index depends on % this.keyMap.length.", what does "ideally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: ideally /aɪˈdiːəli/ (trạng từ): lý tưởng nhất là. Dùng để nêu lựa chọn tốt nhất nhưng không bắt buộc: lý tưởng là kích thước nguyên tố.
items.explanationEn: ideally /aɪˈdiːəli/ (adverb): preferably. Gives the best but optional choice: ideally the new size is a prime.

items.question: Trong câu "One resize is O(n), but because the size doubles, resizes get exponentially rarer.", từ "exponentially" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One resize is O(n), but because the size doubles, resizes get exponentially rarer.", what does "exponentially" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: exponentially /ˌekspəˈnenʃəli/ (trạng từ): theo cấp số nhân. "Grow exponentially" = tăng theo cấp số nhân; ở đây số lần resize thưa dần rất nhanh.
items.explanationEn: exponentially /ˌekspəˈnenʃəli/ (adverb): at a multiplying rate. "Grow exponentially" means multiply repeatedly; here resizes become rare very fast.

items.question: Trong câu "Averaged over many inserts, set stays amortized O(1) — the same argument as a dynamic array's push.", từ "amortized" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Averaged over many inserts, set stays amortized O(1) — the same argument as a dynamic array's push.", what does "amortized" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: amortized /ˈæmətaɪzd/ (tính từ): tính bình quân dồn. "Amortized O(1)" = chi phí trung bình mỗi thao tác là O(1) khi tính dồn qua nhiều lần.
items.explanationEn: amortized /ˈæmətaɪzd/ (adjective): averaged over many operations. "Amortized O(1)" means the cost per operation is O(1) when spread over many operations.

items.question: Trong câu "Averaged over many inserts, set stays amortized O(1) — the same argument as a dynamic array's push.", từ "argument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Averaged over many inserts, set stays amortized O(1) — the same argument as a dynamic array's push.", what does "argument" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a value passed to a function
items.explanation: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (danh từ): lập luận. Từ nhiều nghĩa: ở đây là lập luận chứng minh, không phải cãi nhau hay tham số hàm.
items.explanationEn: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (noun): a line of reasoning. A word with many senses: here it is reasoning, not a quarrel or a function parameter.

items.question: Trong câu "Why prefer Map over objects as a dictionary: object keys are coerced to strings (obj[1] and obj["1"] are the same key), inherited keys such as "constructor" can surprise you, and map.size is O(1) whereas Object.keys(obj).length is O(n).", từ "coerce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why prefer Map over objects as a dictionary: object keys are coerced to strings (obj[1] and obj["1"] are the same key), inherited keys such as "constructor" can surprise you, and map.size is O(1) whereas Object.keys(obj).length is O(n).", what does "coerce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: coerce /kəʊˈɜːs/ (động từ): ép kiểu tự động. "Type coercion" = JavaScript tự đổi kiểu, ví dụ khóa 1 bị đổi thành chuỗi "1".
items.explanationEn: coerce /kəʊˈɜːs/ (verb): to force-convert to a type. "Type coercion" is JavaScript converting types automatically, such as key 1 becoming "1".

items.question: Trong câu "Why prefer Map over objects as a dictionary: object keys are coerced to strings (obj[1] and obj["1"] are the same key), inherited keys such as "constructor" can surprise you, and map.size is O(1) whereas Object.keys(obj).length is O(n).", từ "inherited" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why prefer Map over objects as a dictionary: object keys are coerced to strings (obj[1] and obj["1"] are the same key), inherited keys such as "constructor" can surprise you, and map.size is O(1) whereas Object.keys(obj).length is O(n).", what does "inherited" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inherited /ɪnˈherɪtɪd/ (tính từ): được kế thừa. "Inherited properties" = thuộc tính kế thừa từ prototype, như "constructor".
items.explanationEn: inherited /ɪnˈherɪtɪd/ (adjective): passed down from a parent. "Inherited properties" come from the prototype, such as "constructor".

items.question: Trong câu "Why prefer Map over objects as a dictionary: object keys are coerced to strings (obj[1] and obj["1"] are the same key), inherited keys such as "constructor" can surprise you, and map.size is O(1) whereas Object.keys(obj).length is O(n).", từ "whereas" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why prefer Map over objects as a dictionary: object keys are coerced to strings (obj[1] and obj["1"] are the same key), inherited keys such as "constructor" can surprise you, and map.size is O(1) whereas Object.keys(obj).length is O(n).", what does "whereas" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: whereas /ˌweərˈæz/ (liên từ): trong khi đó. Nối hai vế đối lập: map.size là O(1), trong khi Object.keys(obj).length là O(n).
items.explanationEn: whereas /ˌweərˈæz/ (conjunction): while by contrast. Links two contrasting clauses: map.size is O(1), whereas Object.keys(obj).length is O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "Map and Set iterate in insertion order, a guarantee of the language spec layered on top of the hashing.", từ "iterate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map and Set iterate in insertion order, a guarantee of the language spec layered on top of the hashing.", what does "iterate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: iterate /ˈɪtəreɪt/ (động từ): lặp qua các phần tử. "Iterate over a collection" = lặp qua tập hợp; danh từ "iteration" = một vòng lặp.
items.explanationEn: iterate /ˈɪtəreɪt/ (verb): to loop over items. "Iterate over a collection" means loop through it; one pass is an "iteration".

items.question: Trong câu "Map and Set iterate in insertion order, a guarantee of the language spec layered on top of the hashing.", từ "layer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Map and Set iterate in insertion order, a guarantee of the language spec layered on top of the hashing.", what does "layer" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to place as a layer over
items.explanation: layer /ˈleɪə(r)/ (động từ): đặt chồng lên thành lớp. "Layered on top of X" = được xây thêm như một lớp phía trên X.
items.explanationEn: layer /ˈleɪə(r)/ (verb): to place as a layer over. "Layered on top of X" means built as an extra layer above X.

items.question: Trong câu "Typical interview uses: counting and duplicate detection (the frequency counter pattern), grouping anagrams, Two Sum (store value → index, look up target - x in O(1), turning O(n²) into O(n)), memoization, and the lookup half of an LRU cache.", từ "frequency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Typical interview uses: counting and duplicate detection (the frequency counter pattern), grouping anagrams, Two Sum (store value → index, look up target - x in O(1), turning O(n²) into O(n)), memoization, and the lookup half of an LRU cache.", what does "frequency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the rate of a radio wave
items.explanation: frequency /ˈfriːkwənsi/ (danh từ): số lần xuất hiện. "Frequency counter" = mẫu dùng object/Map đếm số lần mỗi phần tử xuất hiện.
items.explanationEn: frequency /ˈfriːkwənsi/ (noun): how often something occurs. A "frequency counter" uses an object or Map to count how often each item appears.

items.question: Trong câu "Typical interview uses: counting and duplicate detection (the frequency counter pattern), grouping anagrams, Two Sum (store value → index, look up target - x in O(1), turning O(n²) into O(n)), memoization, and the lookup half of an LRU cache.", từ "detection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Typical interview uses: counting and duplicate detection (the frequency counter pattern), grouping anagrams, Two Sum (store value → index, look up target - x in O(1), turning O(n²) into O(n)), memoization, and the lookup half of an LRU cache.", what does "detection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: detection /dɪˈtekʃn/ (danh từ): sự phát hiện. "Duplicate detection" = phát hiện phần tử trùng; động từ là "detect".
items.explanationEn: detection /dɪˈtekʃn/ (noun): the act of noticing. "Duplicate detection" means finding repeated items; the verb is "detect".

items.question: Trong câu "Collisions are unavoidable (pigeonhole, birthday paradox).", từ "unavoidable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Collisions are unavoidable (pigeonhole, birthday paradox).", what does "unavoidable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unavoidable /ˌʌnəˈvɔɪdəbl/ (tính từ): không thể tránh. Đồng nghĩa với "inevitable"; vì vậy mọi hash table đều cần cách xử lý xung đột.
items.explanationEn: unavoidable /ˌʌnəˈvɔɪdəbl/ (adjective): impossible to prevent. A synonym of "inevitable"; that is why every hash table needs collision handling.

items.question: Trong câu "Separate chaining keeps a bucket per slot; linear probing walks to the next free slot and suffers clustering and needs tombstones.", từ "suffer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Separate chaining keeps a bucket per slot; linear probing walks to the next free slot and suffers clustering and needs tombstones.", what does "suffer" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to be affected by a problem
items.explanation: suffer /ˈsʌfə(r)/ (động từ): gặp phải (vấn đề). "Suffer (from) a problem" = bị một vấn đề ảnh hưởng; linear probing bị dồn cục.
items.explanationEn: suffer /ˈsʌfə(r)/ (verb): to be affected by a problem. "Suffer (from) a problem" means be affected by it; linear probing suffers from clustering.

items.question: Trong câu "No ordering: need sorted data or range queries → use a BST, not a hash table.", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No ordering: need sorted data or range queries → use a BST, not a hash table.", what does "range" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: range /reɪndʒ/ (danh từ): khoảng giá trị. "Range query" = truy vấn mọi khóa trong một khoảng, ví dụ từ 10 đến 20.
items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): a span between two values. A "range query" asks for all keys within a span, such as 10 to 20.

items.question: Trong câu "Good hashes are fast, spread keys uniformly and always return the same index for the same key.", từ "uniformly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Good hashes are fast, spread keys uniformly and always return the same index for the same key.", what does "uniformly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: uniformly /ˈjuːnɪfɔːmli/ (trạng từ): đồng đều. "Uniformly distributed" = phân bố đều; tính từ là "uniform".
items.explanationEn: uniformly /ˈjuːnɪfɔːmli/ (adverb): evenly throughout. "Uniformly distributed" means evenly spread; the adjective is "uniform".

items.question: Trong câu "Keeping the load factor low through resizing and rehashing is what keeps operations O(1) in practice.", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keeping the load factor low through resizing and rehashing is what keeps operations O(1) in practice.", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. "In practice" đối lập với "in theory": lý thuyết có trường hợp xấu, thực tế vẫn O(1).
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (phrase): in real use. "In practice" contrasts with "in theory": the worst case exists, but real use stays O(1).
